plays: Trim SOXL: This leveraged chip bull is down 63.85% and decaying. Consider trimming to reduce exposure to its volatility and decay.
Respect SMH stop: Your SMH position is down over 20%. Be ready to respect its stop at 540 to prevent further significant losses.
